comparison_summary.unitika_position: Sub-scale specialty player. ¥126B revenue is 5% of Toray and 12% of Teijin. Strategy: shrink to ¥70B and chase OP margin >9% in chip-substrate glass fibers + retort barrier film + release film
comparison_summary.the_question: Can Unitika achieve a 9.3% OP margin in specialty materials when Toray (with scale advantages, carbon fiber leadership, and diversified electronic materials) runs 5.6%? The answer depends entirely on whether the chip-substrate glass fiber + UniPeel release film + EMBLEM HG retort film franchises grow fast enough to outweigh the residual commodity exposure.
